tools.name: risk_token
tools.description: Token verdict before you buy, hold or accept a token: an A-F grade and a plain-language summary, with every signal behind it (mint, pause, blacklist and fee powers, upgradeable proxy, owner, DEX liquidity, market age, volume) and a list of what was not checked. Send back the fingerprint as since to

tools.name: x402_seller
tools.description: History of an x402 seller before your agent pays it: how long the resource has been tracked, whether its recipient wallet or price changed, and how often it answers. A change of recipient is the signal to stop and look. Untracked resources are not charged. Price: 0.010 USDC per call over x402 on Bas

tools.name: security_app_check
tools.description: Security check of a web app built with AI: exposed secrets in the browser bundle, Supabase tables readable without login, open Firebase databases, published .env or .git files, and missing headers. Each finding has a fix. The app owner must publish a verification token first; get it with POST /app-c

tools.name: risk_portfolio
tools.description: Portfolio risk report for treasuries and large wallets: up to 25 tokens checked in one call, with balance, USD value, a verdict per position, value held in flagged tokens and the largest concentration. Pass the wallet and its tokens. A failed read is not charged. Price: 1.000 USDC per call over x402

tools.name: evm_block
tools.description: Block number on Base: the latest block height, timestamp, age, base fee, gas used and transaction count. Use it when an agent needs the current block number or the chain head. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_gas
tools.description: Gas price on Base in gwei, split into base fee and priority fee, with the block it was read at. Use it to estimate gas fees before sending a transaction. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_balance
tools.description: Wallet balance on Base: the native ETH balance for any address, in wei and ETH, with the block height it was read at. Use it to read a wallet balance. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_token_balance
tools.description: Token balance on Base: the ERC20 balance of an address, with raw units, decimals and the token symbol resolved on-chain. Use it to read a token balance. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_nonce
tools.description: Wallet nonce on Base: the next transaction nonce for any address. Use it to build a transaction without racing the mempool. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_tx
tools.description: Transaction lookup on Base by hash: decoded from, to, value, nonce, gas and max fee, and whether it is mined or pending. Use it to inspect any transaction. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_receipt
tools.description: Transaction receipt on Base: success or reverted, block, gas used, effective gas price, log count and created contract. Use it to confirm a transaction or read its status. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_transfers
tools.description: ERC20 transfers on Base for an address over the last N blocks (default 5000), newest first, with tx hashes. Use it to list incoming token transfers. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: crypto_price
tools.description: Crypto price and token price in USD with 24h change and market cap for one or more CoinGecko ids (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, ...). Use it when an agent needs a current price before quoting or sizing a trade. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: dex_quote
tools.description: DEX quote and liquidity: live pair quotes for a token or pair query, with price in USD, liquidity and 24h volume across chains. Use it to compare venues before a swap. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_tx_status
tools.description: Transaction status on Base: success, reverted or pending for a given transaction hash, with block number, confirmations and gas used. Use it to check whether a transfer confirmed. Price: 0.001 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_token_info
tools.description: Token metadata for an ERC20 contract on Base: name, symbol, decimals and total supply. Use it before formatting any token amount or price. Price: 0.002 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_contract
tools.description: Contract check and ABI for an address on Base: whether it is a contract, its bytecode size, whether Sourcify verified it, and the ABI when available. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_portfolio
tools.description: Portfolio for a wallet on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum in one call: native balance, nonce and the balance of up to ten ERC20 tokens with symbol and decimals. Use it when an agent needs a full wallet snapshot instead of many calls. Price: 0.005 USDC per call over x402 on Base or Solana.

tools.name: evm_decode
tools.description: Decode an EVM transaction: given a transaction hash, or raw calldata plus a contract address, return the function selector, every known signature for it and the decoded static arguments. Use it to explain what a transaction does before signing or reporting it. Price: 0.003 USDC per call over x402 on

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security_app_check" references sensitive artifacts (.env, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Security check of a web app built with AI: exposed secrets in the browser bundle, Supabase tables readable without login, open Firebase databases, published .en…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: security_app_check · Private data: risk_token, x402_seller, security_app_check, risk_portfolio, evm_balance, evm_token_balance, evm_nonce, evm_transfers, crypto_price, dex_quote, evm_token_info, evm_portfolio · Public sink: risk_token, security_app_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: security_app_check · Private data: risk_token, x402_seller, security_app_check, risk_portfolio, evm_balance, evm_token_balance, evm_nonce, evm_transfers, crypto_price, dex_quote, evm_token_info, evm_portfolio · Public sink: risk_token, security_app_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
